## LLM - Call Stream (Multi-Provider BYOT)

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/llm-call-stream

**Description:** Streaming LLM multi-provider avec pattern callback asynchrone.

**InputSchema:**
```json
{
  "required": ["provider", "model", "api_key", "messages", "callback_url", "correlation_id"],
  "properties": {
    "provider": { "enum": ["anthropic", "openai", "mistral"] },
    "model": { "type": "string" },
    "api_key": { "type": "string", "description": "REQUIRED, no fallback" },
    "system": { "type": "string" },
    "messages": { "type": "array" },
    "max_tokens": { "type": "integer", "default": 4096 },
    "temperature": { "type": "number", "default": 0.7 },
    "callback_url": { "type": "string", "description": "URL for async packet delivery" },
    "correlation_id": { "type": "string" },
    "stream_config": {
      "flush_timeout_ms": 500,
      "flush_token_count": 20,
      "flush_size_bytes": 4096
    },
    "metadata": { "type": "object" }
  }
}
```

**Output (immediate):**
```json
{ "status": "streaming", "correlation_id": "..." }
```

**Callbacks:** POST to callback_url with chunk packets
